title: Week 5 Listening: A Busy Week with Changes
text:
Mia: Hi, Leo. Do you work every day?
Leo: No, I don't. I work Monday to Friday. But this week is different.
Mia: Why?
Leo: My sister visits on Thursday. So I stay home on Thursday.
Mia: Do you go to the gym on Thursday?
Leo: No, I don't. I go to the gym on Tuesday and Friday.
Mia: What time do you start work?
Leo: I start at nine. I finish at five.
Mia: Do you have lunch at home?
Leo: No, I don't. I eat lunch at a café near my office.
Mia: Do you study English in the evening?
Leo: Yes, I do. I study English on Monday and Wednesday. I don't study on Friday.
Mia: OK. See you on Thursday!
Leo: See you!
